controllerType: C7-A overlock sewing machine panel V1.3
type: Overlock / serger machine (包缝机) controller with electric presser foot lift motor and IoT
source: C7-A包缝机面板操作说明书V1.3_20260618_中英文(1)(2).pdf (V1.3, 2026-06-18, bilingual, ~22 pages)
note: C7-A is a significantly more advanced overlock controller than C5. Key additions: (1) Electric presser foot lift motor (servo-controlled) with dedicated error codes E31-E57 and process params U33/U34/U80-U103; (2) Short thread sensor as a dedicated separate sensor (U21/U22, not the 'fourth sensor' of C5); (3) IoT/WiFi networking built-in with serial number setting (P116, sections 2.16-2.18); (4) 15 buttons including dedicated front-cut +/-, back-cut +/-, suction, and sensor buttons; (5) Extended P73 factory speed presets (0-7 vs C5's 0-1); (6) P2 needle positioning options extended to 0-5; (7) Suction button enables quick thread length adjustment. Electromagnetic valve interface (section 8): RS/SD type — 24V pin8=wire loosener, 24V pin9=suction chip (lower), 24V pin10=0V, 5V pin11, 24V pin12, 24V pin13=suction whip, 24V pin14.

parameterEntry.userParams: Long press P for 1.5s → enter user parameter mode. Left/right choose parameter. Up/down modify value. Press P to confirm and save. 10s without press: exits without saving.
parameterEntry.technicianParams: Press P + Presser Foot Lifter button simultaneously for 1.5s → shows P26. Navigate and modify same as user params. 10s timeout.
parameterEntry.processParams: Press P + Down button for 1.5s → shows U1. Navigate and modify same as above. 10s timeout.
parameterEntry.systemParams: Press P + Up button for 1.5s → R&D parameter password input. Enter password. Navigate by right button to find param. Modify up/down. Press P briefly to save.
parameterEntry.monitoring: Press P + Right button → enter monitoring interface. Left/right adjust monitoring items. Press P to enter current monitoring value. Short press P to exit.
parameterEntry.speedAdjust: In standby: up/down buttons adjust max speed ±100 RPM. Press P to save. 10s no button: exits without saving.
parameterEntry.frontCutLineAdjust: When P94=8: press front cut button → modifies P30 (front trimming suction close needles). When P94=6 or 7, U24=0: press front cut → modifies P27 (delay stitches). When P94=6/7, U24=1, B mode: press → modifies U104. Use front cut +/- buttons to adjust. Press P to save.
parameterEntry.backCutLineAdjust: When P94=8: press back cut button → modifies P31 (delay time after back suction off). When P94=6 or 7, P32=0: press → modifies P28 (delay stitches). When P94=6/7, P32=1: press → modifies P50 (anti-cutting sensor delay stitches). Use back cut +/- buttons. Press P to save.
parameterEntry.suctionParamAdjust: Short press suction button → modifies P46 (feeding and suction mode after thread cutting). Up/down to change value. Press P to save briefly.
parameterEntry.buttonLock: Set P62=1 to lock. Long press Trimmer parameter button for 1.5s to unlock.
parameterEntry.shortThreadModeSwitch: Long press Suction button for 1.5s → toggle front and back short thread trimmer on/off. When on: short thread sensor auto enabled and recalibrated. Shows OK on success.
parameterEntry.sensorAutoCalibration: Long press Sensor button for 1.5s → sensor auto calibration. Shows OK if successful.
parameterEntry.iotSerialNumber: Short press P + Up button → enter R&D param password. Navigate to P116 → set to 1 → save briefly. Panel enters IoT serial number setting interface. Up/down sets flashing digit value. Left/right selects digit. Serial number is 11 digits. After setting: P + Trimmer button to save. Short press P to exit without saving.
parameterEntry.iotNetworkErrorCheck: When panel disconnects from IoT collector for 1 min: alarm A13. Collector-gateway disconnect: alarm A11. Gateway-server disconnect: alarm A12. View these through M15.
parameterEntry.fastBindDevice: After confirming IoT serial number: press Up + Presser Foot Lifter button. Panel shows OK = binding successful.
parameterEntry.restoreFactory: Long press Reset 2s: restore user saved params. Long press Left+Right 2s: restore factory params. Not restored: P66/P67/P68 adapter duty cycle, P73 factory speed, P90 monitoring enable, P94/P95 model selection, P103 force electric presser foot.

sewingModes.note: Same as C5 — P5 selects mode. Switching modes restores that mode's saved values for P1/P3/P27/P28/P50.

troubleshooting.issue: E06 presser foot protection alarm won't clear
troubleshooting.cause: Presser foot not in correct position
troubleshooting.solution: Place presser foot back in correct position, then press P button to clear E06 error.

troubleshooting.issue: Presser foot height not adjusting correctly
troubleshooting.cause: U33/U34 parameters or motor calibration needed
troubleshooting.solution: Repeatedly press Presser Foot Lifter button to switch to foot height adjustment mode. Up/down buttons adjust height (shown in mm on 5th/6th digit). Check U33 (height gear), U34 (slight height), U35 (idle zero angle), U69/U70 (height compensation angles).

troubleshooting.issue: Thread tail too long after cutting
troubleshooting.solution: Use front cut line +/- buttons to adjust. When P94=6/7, U24=0: adjusts P27. When U24=1: adjusts U104. Smaller value = shorter thread tail.

troubleshooting.cause: Short thread sensor disabled or not calibrated
troubleshooting.solution: Long press Suction button 1.5s to toggle short thread mode. Check U22=1 (enable) and U24=0 for C7-A (vs C5 default U24=1). Long press Sensor button 1.5s for calibration.

troubleshooting.cause: Serial number not set or IoT module not configured
troubleshooting.solution: Enter R&D params (P+Up), navigate to P116, set to 1, save. Panel enters IoT serial number setting. Set 11-digit serial. Save with P+Trimmer. Check WiFi icon on LCD — always on=normal, flashing=disconnected, off=not configured.

troubleshooting.issue: E57 high speed serial communication fault
troubleshooting.cause: U94=1 (high speed) but adapter board connection issue
troubleshooting.solution: Check adapter board to control box connection. Set U94=0 to switch to normal serial communication. Try factory reset or restart.
